title: Q-PROMO-social: keep the social promotion channel live
body:
**Owner:** marketing-manager
**Trigger:** every promote --plan pass
**Done check:** grep:ops/promotion/outcomes.jsonl::"channel": "social"
**Prediction:** promotion_outcomes_recorded >= 1 within 336 h
**Status:** open

Route: scripts/social_post.py fed by foundation/reach.py (events to posts); posts when the account bindings exist. Signal back: social referrals in first-party hits (reach metric social_referrals_7d). Record the result with `python3 -m foundation promote --outcome social --kind listed|silent`; the outcome re-weights the channel.
